ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (approx. 90% of fluke area) contrasted by high-intensity linear features and textured tips against a saturated high-intensity background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity regions across both lobes; discrete high-intensity linear streaks distributed globally; high-intensity textured clusters located at coordinates corresponding to the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Centrally located V-shaped indentation with an estimated vertex angle of 100 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively smooth trailing edge boundary with low-amplitude variations; extreme distal sections exhibit high-frequency, high-amplitude protrusions from the primary curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-directional curvature; concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity textured clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, appearing as aggregates of roughly circular forms.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional high-contrast linear markings across the entire dark surface area, with prominent vertical and diagonal streaks in the lower-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible high-intensity textured clusters at the lateral tips and pervasive white linear scarring across the main surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated high-intensity pixel cluster located at the lower center, near the water-to-fluke interface.
